Its stated coverage is The Netherlands; initially Amsterdam-Amstelland and adaptable with compatible local data. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use.
